list.name: agent
list.label: Agent
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT agent_id FROM net_events ORDER BY 1;

list.name: event_type
list.label: Event Type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT event_type FROM net_events ORDER BY 1;

list.name: severity
list.label: Alert Severity
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT severity FROM alerts ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE "timestamp" >= NOW() - interval '5 minutes' AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}');

SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE "timestamp" >= NOW() - interval '1 hour' AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}');
SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE "timestamp" >= NOW() - interval '1 hour';
SELECT MAX("timestamp") AS last_event_ts FROM net_events WHERE ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}');
SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM alerts WHERE created_at >= NOW() - interval '1 hour' AND ('${severity}' = '%' OR severity = '${severity}');

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '1m'), event_type AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '1m'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'flow' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '1m'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'ssh_auth' AND COALESCE(extra->>'action','') IN ('failed_password','invalid_user','max_auth_attempts') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT "timestamp" AS time, agent_id, src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, proto, COALESCE(extra->>'action','') AS action, COALESCE(extra->>'user', extra->>'username', '') AS username, COALESCE(extra->>'method','') AS method, extra::text AS extra_json FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'ssh_auth' ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 200;

SELECT src_ip, COUNT(*)::bigint AS events FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}') AND src_ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT dst_port::text AS "port", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count" FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'flow' AND dst_port IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1m'), severity AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('${severity}' = '%' OR severity = '${severity}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT created_at AS time, rule_id, severity, src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, description, details::text AS details_json FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('${severity}' = '%' OR severity = '${severity}') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT "timestamp" AS time, agent_id, event_type, src_ip, src_port, dst_ip, dst_port, proto, bytes, extra::text AS extra_json FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}') ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 200;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '1m'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'lateral_conn' AND COALESCE(extra->>'lateral_kind','') = 'attempt' AND dst_port IN (445,3389,5985,5986,135,139) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT "timestamp" AS time, agent_id, src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, proto, COALESCE(extra->>'lateral_kind','') AS lateral_kind, extra::text AS extra_json FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'lateral_conn' AND COALESCE(extra->>'lateral_kind','') = 'attempt' ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 200;

SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE "timestamp" >= NOW() - interval '5 minutes' AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%');

SELECT NOW() AS time, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'confidence','')::double precision), 0)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE "timestamp" >= NOW() - interval '5 minutes' AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%');

SELECT COALESCE(extra->>'attack_kind','unknown') AS attack_kind FROM net_events WHERE ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(dst_ip,''), CASE WHEN dst_port IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ':' || dst_port::text END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(proto,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE '/' || proto END) AS target FROM net_events WHERE ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: DoS/DDoS detections per minute by kind

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '1m'), COALESCE(extra->>'attack_kind','unknown') AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT "time", metric, value FROM ( SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'confidence' AS metric, MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'confidence','')::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND NULLIF(extra->>'confidence','') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'syn_ratio' AS metric, MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'syn_ratio','')::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND NULLIF(extra->>'syn_ratio','') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ) s ORDER BY 1;

SELECT "time", metric, value FROM ( SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'pps' AS metric, MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'pps','')::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND NULLIF(extra->>'pps','') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'bps' AS metric, MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'bps','')::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND NULLIF(extra->>'bps','') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ) s ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: L7 signals (HTTP RPS / TLS HS RPS max)

targets.rawSql: SELECT "time", metric, value FROM ( SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'http_rps' AS metric, MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'http_rps','')::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND NULLIF(extra->>'http_rps','') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'tls_hs_rps' AS metric, MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'tls_hs_rps','')::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND NULLIF(extra->>'tls_hs_rps','') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ) s ORDER BY 1;

SELECT "time", metric, value FROM ( SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'src_ips_est' AS metric, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(extra->>'src_ips_est',''), NULLIF(extra->>'src_ips',''))::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(extra->>'src_ips_est',''), NULLIF(extra->>'src_ips','')) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'src_entropy_norm' AS metric, MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'src_entropy_norm','')::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND NULLIF(extra->>'src_entropy_norm','') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ) s ORDER BY 1;

SELECT "timestamp" AS time, agent_id, event_type, src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, proto, COALESCE(extra->>'attack_kind','') AS attack_kind, COALESCE(extra->>'confidence','') AS confidence, COALESCE(extra->>'pps','') AS pps, COALESCE(extra->>'bps','') AS bps, COALESCE(extra->>'http_rps','') AS http_rps, COALESCE(extra->>'tls_hs_rps','') AS tls_hs_rps, extra::text AS extra_json FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 200;
